title: An agreement open for one representative of a compatible fpqc datum
statement: Let $S$, $T_i$, $g_i$, $F$, and $s_i$ be as follows: $S$ is a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\{g_i:T_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], $F$ is a sheaf of sets on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets, def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $s_i\in(g_i^{-1}F)(T_i)$ have equal double-overlap pullbacks under the unit-compatible composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units, def-pc-fibre-product]. Fix $i\in I$, an étale object $Z/T_i$ with its arrow $\pi:Z\to T_i$, an étale object $V/S$, a $T_i$-morphism $a:Z\to V\times_S T_i$, and $t\in F(V)$ such that $\pi^*s_i=a^*\eta_{g_i,V}(t)$. There exists an open $U\subset V$ containing the image of $Z\xrightarrow{a}V\times_ST_i\to V$, such that for $W=U$ considered as an étale object over $S$ and $b:W\to V$ its inclusion, $\eta_{g_j,W}(F(b)(t))$ equals the restriction of $s_j$ along $W\times_ST_j\to T_j$ for every $j$. This asserts neither a covering of $S$ nor compatibility of different local representatives.

proof.text: For each j apply the ordinary-etale agreement-open criterion to the unit image of t and the restriction of s_j on V times_S T_j. Choose these uniquely determined opens E_j. Apply the overlap compatibility theorem to hcompat and their criteria.

By Mathlib Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback, the first projections V times_S T_j to V form an fpqc covering (using IsPullback.of_hasPullback). Apply openSubscheme_existsUnique_of_fpqc directly to this family and the compatible E_j, obtaining U with inverse images E_j. This is the same fpqc open descent as the former etale wrapper, in the fibre-product orientation used by the inverse-image functor.

The maps a followed by the projection to the terminal etale object and pi are equal by their over-category equations. Thus hrep and the ordinary agreement-open criterion put range(a.left) in E_i. The equality E_i=projection inverse image of U puts the projected range in U.

For W=U and its inclusion b, the base-change morphism m=beta.map b has range in E_j: its first projection factors through U. The agreement-open criterion gives equality after restriction along m. Naturality of the adjunction unit identifies the first restriction with the unit image of t restricted along b. The composite m with the terminal projection is the structure map of beta.obj W, by over-category equations. Substitute these equations to obtain the asserted matching equality.
